## What this issue is about
This issue proposes the implementation of Quanta, Plone's new Design System, within Plone Volto. The goal is to enhance the theming experience by clearly separating the Public Theme from the CMSUI (Content Management System User Interface). 

## What needs to be done
- Implement the Quanta Design System, ensuring it is independent of other design systems like SemanticUI.
- Redesign Volto’s theming approach for better flexibility and customization.
- Create essential components for both the CMSUI and Public Theme, and ensure documentation is updated.

## Helpful background
The Quanta Design System aims to unify the look and feel of the CMSUI while allowing flexibility in public theming. Required components will be based on SCSS and require the use of the Volto Component Registry. Note that there are ongoing discussions, particularly regarding documentation needs and site upgrades.

## Good first steps
1. Review the [Figma mockups](https://www.figma.com/file/lWRIiKmcy1kMRl1DgLkCSL/Quanta?t=pyh04lHU2vmBer8g-6) for design reference.
2. Familiarize yourself with the existing [Volto codebase](https://github.com/plone/volto).
3. Check the deliverables list for the necessary components to develop.
4. Join discussions on documentation to understand the upgrade process for existing sites.
